title: Honest work makes the path visible
summary: The true guide is recognized in honest work and generous sharing, not in spiritual display. Gather the mind before you call it service.
takeaway: Gather the mind before you call it service.
lifeApplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.

source.shortMeaning: The true guide is recognized in honest work and generous sharing, not in spiritual display.
source.lifeApplication: Do one useful thing cleanly and quietly, then let the giving matter more than the appearance of being good.

evidence.coreClaim: The true guide is recognized in honest work and generous sharing, not in spiritual display.
evidence.turn: Honest labor and sharing reveal the path better than costume.
evidence.practicalImplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.
